title: Building Block Steps Viewer
prompt:
Use Three.js to implement an "LDraw-like" 15-step building block assembly instruction viewer: each step adds several colored blocks (bricks), with support for a step slider, an exploded view, and displaying parts from steps not yet reached in gray.

[Three.js Import Method (Must Be Followed Strictly)]
Use the following importmap in <head>, and import via ES Modules in <script type="module">:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
</script>

[Model and Steps]
(1) There are 15 assembly steps in total (totalSteps=15). From step 1 through step 15, progressively stack colored BoxGeometry bricks to form stable structures such as a tower or wall (the specific layout is up to you, but each step must add at least 1 brick; a cumulative total of 25–40 bricks is recommended).
(2) currentStep controls the display: show all bricks introduced in the current step or any previous step; if "future parts" that have not yet appeared are previewed, use a gray material (#888888 or similar) to distinguish them from completed colored bricks; in exploded mode, offset each brick along its normal or outward from the center.
(3) id="stepSlider": <input type="range" min="1" max="15" step="1" />, synchronized bidirectionally with currentStep.
(4) id="explodeToggle": checkbox; enabling it sets explodeMode=true, and disabling it sets explodeMode=false.
(5) Optional text display: "Step n / 15".

[State Exposure (Required)]
window.__3D_STATE__ = {
  currentStep: number,      // 1..15
  totalSteps: number,       // Always 15
  visibleBricks: number,    // Number of bricks that should currently be rendered (independent of explosion; the number of bricks accumulated through this step)
  totalBricks: number,      // Total number of bricks after all 15 steps are completed
  explodeMode: boolean
}

[Evaluation Helpers (Recommended)]
(6) window.__STATEPROBE_setStep__(n: number), window.__STATEPROBE_setExplode__(v: boolean).

Output a single HTML file that runs when opened directly in a browser.
